prompts.name: MintGlass
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single full-resolution 1536x1024 landscape wallpaper for a real Roblox interface. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE ATLAS. Use ONLY the TOP LEFT mint-glass artwork as the reference. Recreate that single wallpaper at full resolution, filling the entire canvas with near-black graphite #0A1216 and refined translucent mint/teal light ribbons. A slender luminous ribbon rises from lower left and curls toward upper right. Sculptural fine glass edges, controlled glow, subtle natural grain. Keep the upper left and center mostly dark with generous negative space for real UI text. Sharply defined ribbon edges, no lens blur, no bokeh, no noisy particle cloud. This is ONE mint wallpaper, not four quadrants. Absolutely no other palette, no orange, no purple, no blue grid, no dividing line, no collage, no frame, no UI, no text, no logo, no watermark. Preserve the elegant material language of the reference while making the art restrained enough for background use.
